DownloadTask.abort()

Stop downloading tasks (Minimum version: 23.6.0)

Sample Code

const downloadTask = ma.downloadFile({
    url: 'http://example.com/audio/123', //This is only an example and is not a real resource.
    success(res) {
        ma.playVoice({
            filePath: res.tempFilePath
        })
    }
})

downloadTask.abort() // Cancel the download task.
